notes.text:
Observations: On 2026-08-01, Fern 1.0 native mode lost transparent pixels in a transparent-PNG test (200 ms); compatibility preserved them (600 ms) [alpha-defect]. On 2026-08-02, Fern 1.0 native mode correctly exported an opaque JPEG (200 ms); transparency was not retested [opaque-success]. On 2026-08-03, after installing Fern 1.1, the same transparent-PNG test preserved all transparent pixels in both native (200 ms) and compatibility (600 ms) modes [alpha-fixed].
Conclusions: For this tested PNG on 1.1, native preserved transparency and completed faster than compatibility; the 1.0 transparency failure is historical, and the opaque-JPEG success did not resolve or retest it [alpha-defect, opaque-success, alpha-fixed]. These local synthetic tests do not establish behavior for other inputs or general performance. Version 1.1 is current according to the latest captured evidence (2026-08-03); no newer verification is available, so present installation status is unverified.
